body:
Banded Agate is the definition of steady. With its natural layers and grounding presence, it’s traditionally associated with balance, protection, and emotional stabilization—like a deep exhale you can hold in your hand. We love it for nervous system work because it supports regulation without forcing: calm, cool, and consistent.

This Healing Gua Sha is carved in a multi-curve shape to meet your body where stress lives. The long edge is made for broad, downward strokes along the neck and gentle sweeps across the chest—perfect for lymphatic support and a “settling” signal to the body. The rounded curves naturally fit the jaw and cheek, helping release facial holding patterns that build from concentration, anxiety, or poor sleep. The notch is ideal for tracing along the neck muscles with control, especially when you want precision without pressure. And the smaller tip can be used around the ear line and along tight, tiny zones for targeted relief.

When we talk about “vibrational balance,” we’re describing a real felt shift: a slower internal pace, smoother breath, softer jaw, clearer mind. Used consistently, gua sha becomes a nervous system cue—rhythm + touch + breath—supporting vagal tone and helping your body move out of fight-or-flight and back toward calm regulation.

Keep this piece on your nightstand, vanity, or desk. It’s not just skincare. It’s a regulation ritual.
